source: lab task L0, 2026-09-10 04:08, the second of two captures in one sitting. Same reset dance as the 115200 half; the port is reopened at the app's own baud because the app reprograms clkdiv mid-stream and one capture cannot read both rates.
note:
THE BOARD IS RUNNING A DIRTY TREE (2e21b6226bcd-dirty) — see the 115200 sidecar and ruling R7. This half opens mid-symbol, so the first ~13 KB of the file is the tail of the bootloader's bytes read at the wrong rate; the app console begins at '[INIT] fw-esp32v3 boot'.

TWO THINGS IN THIS CAPTURE ARE NOT WHAT M3 PRODUCES, AND BOTH ARE CORRECT.
(1) The line '[INIT] RMT ISR on APP core'. M3 is single-core (Q5) and the firmware takes its documented fallback, printing '[INIT] APP core unavailable; RMT ISR on PRO core (single-core semantics)' instead (lp-fw/fw-esp32v3/src/main.rs:838-845). Heap region 3 is added in BOTH arms (main.rs:846-855 explains why it sits outside the branch), so the heap arithmetic is unaffected. G2's comparison is over memory-class fields, not over log text.
(2) The '[stack] heartbeat:' / '[MEM]' / '[JIT]' triple in this capture is NOT idle-emitted. It comes from esp32_memory_stats, which lpa_server calls from log_memory on a project load/unload/stop and from runtime_status on a client read — and this board auto-loads the 'Zook dome' project at boot, which is what calls it here. An emulator booting a blank lpfs has no project to load and therefore prints no triple until a client asks for one; the P8 gate runs elicit it with a scripted 'stopAllProjects' over UART0, which reaches the same call site.

Boot heap line: heap=15072+112640+98304+15536=241552; main stack 45488 B; JIT region sram0 ibus 0x40088000..0x40098000 with rwtext_end=0x40083e00. Five wires over four RMT slots on IO18, IO13, IO2, IO14, IO16.
